law_name: Law Providing for the Protection of Natural Persons with regard to the Processing of Personal Data and for the Free Movement of such Data (Law 125(I)/2018)
key_requirements: Supplements GDPR, lawful basis and data subject rights, Commissioner's powers
enforcement_authority: Office of the Commissioner for Personal Data Protection
deceased_data: No additional national rules on deceased persons' data; GDPR treated as not applying to them
research_exemption: Section 31: safeguards for processing for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research and statistics (GDPR art. 89) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Genetic data defined as inherited or acquired genetic characteristics; processing genetic and biometric data for health and life insurance prohibited unless based on consent
notes: Repealed Law 138(I)/2001; dated by Government Gazette publication on 31 July 2018
